name: TerrainOperation
doc: Operation performed by one recorded brush gesture.

variants.name: raise
variants.doc: Add a smooth radial displacement in metres.

variants.name: hole
variants.doc: Set or clear holes in the selected area.

variants.name: stamp
variants.doc: Add a rotated height stamp sampled from an immutable binary tile.

variants.name: erode
variants.doc: Apply a bounded deterministic thermal relaxation kernel.

variants.name: import
variants.doc: Replace samples from an imported tile inside an ordered, undoable layer.
